profile.headline: Android Engineer
profile.summary: Currently working for Microsoft as a SDE in the APEX team, delivering the best quality products in the Office suite for Apple customers. On my free time I enjoy doing Android development as well as learning new technologies, anything from Unity5 to Google App Engine. I have always loved technology and I am always prototyping new ideas and projects. I also enjoy learning and I hope other will people learn from what I do too.

positions.title: SDE
positions.description: Software Engineer at Microsoft, in the APEX team. Developing world-class software for our customers in the Apple Ecosystem.

positions.title: Mobile Software Developer
positions.description:
-Designed and developed android application that displays and uploads pictures and data to the
overland flood monitor using technologies such as SQLite, HTTP POST/GET and GoogleMaps API.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description:
-Created Debian-based environment for thin clients and managed virtualization servers using vSphere.
-Developed and maintained custom created applications for system administration.
-Administration of network and infrastructure.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Contributor in publication “An Effective Regression Testing Approach for PHP Web Applications”.
-Developed scripts for automation of cleaning and formatting of PHP code.
-Coded automated tool in Perl to execute tool chain of software testing applications and developed
Java front-end application for process tool chain.
